skillshare.summary: The landing page for SkillShare, a collaborative learning and academic networking platform. It introduces the concept and connects students with the community.
skillshare.problem: SkillShare brings together collaborative learning and academic connections. This landing page needs to explain what the platform offers and how it can help students connect.
objectives: Make the information available across devices.
skillshare.solution: A presentation website built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. This case covers the landing page: it introduces the educational platform and its services.

highlights.title: Educational concept
highlights.text: An introduction to SkillShare and its focus on academic collaboration.

highlights.title: Spanish and English
highlights.text: Localized content with translation resources and a language manager.

highlights.title: Responsive design
highlights.text: A presentation accessible on mobile and desktop.

technicalDecisions.title: Static website
technicalDecisions.text: HTML structures the content, CSS adapts the presentation and JavaScript adds interaction.

technicalDecisions.title: Localized content
technicalDecisions.text: Copy is organized in language files, separate from styles and scripts.

technicalDecisions.title: GitHub Pages deployment
technicalDecisions.text: The landing page is distributed as a static website from its repository.

skillshare.results: The portfolio catalog lists this project as in development. The landing page has a public link and a repository; both are available here.

fym.tagline: From browsing to your next movie.
fym.summary: FyM (Find Your Movie) is a web application for exploring movies and TV shows, discovering cast members, browsing scenes and watching trailers.
fym.problem: Exploring a movie also means discovering its cast, watching a trailer and finding related titles. FyM brings this information into a browsing experience dedicated to movies and TV shows.
objectives: Explore movies and shows in a catalog.
Read details and discover audiovisual content.
Find content through search and filters.
fym.solution: A web application built with Next.js and React, using TMDB as its information source. Catalog browsing connects to dedicated detail pages for movies and TV shows.

highlights.title: Explore the catalog
highlights.text: Movies and TV shows with information to help discover what to watch.

highlights.title: Search and filter
highlights.text: Content search, genre filters and sorting options.

highlights.title: Discover the story
highlights.text: Detail pages with cast members, trailers and more information about each title.

technicalDecisions.title: Hybrid rendering
technicalDecisions.text: The README documents server-side data loading and client components for filters and interaction.

technicalDecisions.title: Debounced search
technicalDecisions.text: Search waits for a pause in typing to avoid making a request on every keystroke.

fym.results: The portfolio catalog lists FyM as in production. The application and source code are available through this case study’s links.

meetmesh.summary: A web application for creating and joining virtual meetings, sharing your screen and personalizing profiles.
meetmesh.problem: A virtual meeting needs to bring participants together and let them share what they are seeing. MeetMesh addresses that flow from creating a room to communicating inside it.
meetmesh.solution: A meeting application with a Next.js and React interface. It combines WebRTC, Socket.IO and Supabase for communication, room coordination and user accounts.

highlights.title: Meeting rooms
highlights.text: Create rooms and join using a room code.

highlights.title: Screen sharing
highlights.text: Share visual content during the call.

highlights.title: Personal profiles
highlights.text: Customize your name, username and avatar.

technicalDecisions.title: Browser-to-browser media
technicalDecisions.text: WebRTC carries audio and video between peers. A separate Socket.IO server exchanges signaling messages.

technicalDecisions.title: Identity and profiles
technicalDecisions.text: Supabase provides authentication and storage for profiles.

meetmesh.results: MeetMesh is listed as in development in the portfolio. A repository and web demo are available; calls also depend on the signaling service.

biovision-suite.summary: A desktop application for facial biometric analysis, enrollment, identity comparison and search, with local processing and privacy.
biovision-suite.problem: Biometric analysis handles sensitive information. BioVision Suite focuses on performing facial processing and storage on the device, without depending on a cloud API to operate.
objectives: Enroll people with image quality checks.
Compare faces and search for matches.
Analyze images, cameras and video locally.
biovision-suite.solution: A Python and PySide6 desktop suite combining computer vision, ONNX Runtime inference, FAISS vector search, and persistence with SQLite and SQLAlchemy.

highlights.title: Enrollment
highlights.text: Register people with image quality validation.

highlights.title: 1:N search
highlights.text: Find matches within the collection using FAISS.

highlights.title: Camera and video
highlights.text: Facial recognition and video file analysis.

technicalDecisions.title: Separate layers
technicalDecisions.text: The PySide6 interface is separated from services, vision engines and persistence repositories.

technicalDecisions.title: Local operation
technicalDecisions.text: Models are downloaded on the first run. Afterwards, inference and storage operate on the device.

biovision-suite.results: BioVision Suite is listed as in development. Its repository documents installation and use; as a desktop application, it has no web demo.
